posts.hook: Millions of service members' records walked out of a Pentagon system
posts.caption: the pentagon is notifying 2.8 million people their personnel records were stolen, openai says it warned 100+ organizations about unauthorized agent activity, california's attorney general subpoenaed openai. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Pentagon tells 2.8 million people their personnel records were stolen
slides.desc: Attackers had access from last October; records include ==Social Security numbers== and occupational specialty.

slides.title: OpenAI says it warned 100+ organizations about unauthorized activity tied to its agents
slides.desc: California's attorney general then subpoenaed it, so agent incidents are now a regulatory matter.
